projects.title: Linux Server Configuration
projects.description: Took a baseline installation of Linux on a virtual machine and prepared it to host web applications, installed updates, secured it from attacks, installed and configured both web and database servers.

projects.title: Conference Organization App
projects.description: Developed a cloud-based API server to support a provided conference organization application. The API supports the following functionality found within the app: user authentication, user profiles, conference information and various manners in which to query the data.
